api.web: WebPreview takes defaultUrl (default empty string) and onUrlChange; WebPreviewNavigationButton adds tooltip to Button props; WebPreviewUrl takes Input props; WebPreviewBody takes iframe props plus loading (ReactNode) and an optional src override; WebPreviewConsole takes logs of level, message and timestamp. WebPreviewUrl, WebPreviewBody and WebPreviewConsole throw if used outside WebPreview, because they read its context.

interaction.web: Typing in WebPreviewUrl keeps local text; pressing Enter calls setUrl, which updates the iframe src and fires onUrlChange. Toolbar buttons fire the caller's onClick and show a tooltip on hover and focus. The Console trigger toggles the Collapsible with click, Enter or Space.

semantics.web: The iframe carries title Preview and a fixed sandbox attribute. The Console trigger is a native button with visible text and Radix aria-expanded and aria-controls.
